summary: Round r1 (restricted network; data hosts blocked). All empirical items are PENDING. Q1 (FDI commitments versus realised inflows), Q2 (approval steps and timelines) and Q3 (repatriation restrictions) are designed but unanswered. Thirty source leads recorded, reused from the shared register and upstream agents (04B, 11A, 16A/16B, 21C, 23E, 26D) plus two portals marked as general-knowledge URLs: NRB FDI survey reports (FY2022/23, FY2023/24), NRB Current Macroeconomic and Financial Situation (BoP), NRB Foreign Investment and Loan Management Bylaw and FXM department, Department of Industry, IBN and the PPP and Investment Act 2019, FITTA 2019 (text and UNCTAD summaries), UNCTAD Investment Policy Monitor and IPR implementation report, India-Nepal BIPPA record and text, InvestNepal treaty downloads, WTO TPR 2025, World Bank CEM 2025, IMF 2026 Article IV, UNCTADstat/WIR and BPM6. Pledges, approvals (DoI and IBN separately), realised BoP inflows, survey stock and UNCTAD calendar-year inflows are kept as separate series and never substituted. India-Nepal BIPPA status is treated as unresolved (26D). No numbers are recorded.

findings.period: Law and NRB directives in force as of 2026
findings.note: From FITTA 2019 repatriation section, NRB Foreign Investment and Loan Management Bylaw and FXM directives. Leads: 12B-L06, L07, L12, L27

findings.claim: Repatriation outflows: dividends and income on FDI (primary income debits) in BoP.
Treaty-based transfer guarantees by BIPPA partner and their status.
findings.note: From 26D register; India-Nepal BIPPA status contested — treated as unresolved. Leads: 12B-L17, L18, L19

findings.claim: Four separate FDI series (pledges; approvals [DoI and IBN]; realised BoP inflows; FDI survey stock) are maintained and never substituted for one another; ODA is excluded from FDI.
findings.note: Accepts 04B's four-category proposal and 16B EXP-12 challenge; ODA tracked by 04B/Agent 02, not here.

findings.claim: Scenario investor-protection assumptions do not presume treaty coverage for India until the India-Nepal BIPPA status is settled from dated instruments.
Approval values are commitments in NPR at the approval date; they are not deflated or converted to realised investment.
findings.note: Definition; conversion to USD, if needed, uses the approval-FY average rate, documented.

data_gaps: Every empirical value: no primary document could be downloaded in r1.
No administrative dataset of actual approval durations was located; statutory time limits are not evidence of practice.
Project-level linkage between DoI/IBN approvals and NRB-recorded inflows is not publicly documented; cohort realisation ratios may be infeasible.
Document-level URLs for DoI FDI statistics, IBN approval records, Foreign Exchange (Regulation) Act and Industrial Enterprises Act 2020 not located.

assumptions.text: Four-plus series (pledges, DoI approvals, IBN approvals, realised BoP, survey stock, UNCTAD CY) kept separate; ODA excluded.
No treaty coverage presumed for India in scenarios until BIPPA status resolved.
BPM6 direct-investment definition is the reference for realised FDI.

challenges.text: Agree the four-category split with one refinement: approvals are split into DoI and IBN sub-series (possible overlap), and UNCTAD calendar-year inflows are a separate fifth series. 12B owns aggregate series; 04B owns China-specific rows drawn from them.

For the FDI commitments-vs-flows conflict, the difference is definitional (gross commitments vs net BoP liabilities incl. reinvested earnings and debt; FY vs CY); record both and classify gap reasons rather than treat as a data error.
Office of Company Registrar and Inland Revenue Department document-level sources for approval-process timelines are needed; ocr_nepal and ird_nepal exist in catalog but no leads were located.

uncertainty: High: no value retrieved. Structural uncertainties: (i) approvals, pledges and BoP inflows measure different things and cannot be reconciled without project-level data; (ii) NRB FDI survey and BoP flow series differ in coverage; (iii) FY vs CY between NRB and UNCTAD; (iv) statutory time limits may diverge widely from practice; (v) repatriation practice depends on NRB directives and foreign-exchange conditions that change over time; (vi) India-Nepal BIPPA status contested, affecting protection assumptions for the largest neighbour.

series.definition: FDI approved under FITTA by DoI (committed foreign capital)
Projects approved by IBN under PPP and Investment Act
BPM6 direct investment liabilities, net (NRB BoP)
NRB FDI survey stock and composition

fdi_commitment_realisation.comparison_method: Present S2 and S3 side by side by FY; compute aggregate ratio S3/S2 with explicit caveat; cohort realisation only if project-level linkage exists; reasons for gap classified (not yet disbursed, cancelled, reinvested earnings in S3 without approval, debt instruments, valuation, timing).
fdi_commitment_realisation.conflict_register: Feeds 00B FDI commitments-vs-flows conflict entry; both values kept (CLAUDE.md rule 4).
methodological_issues: Approvals are gross commitments; BoP is net and includes reinvested earnings and intercompany debt
DoI and IBN approvals can overlap
Exchange-rate effects must be separated in USD series
